I had Alarmed for over a decade and they stopped updating it which caused glitches.  I have at least 10 reminders daily so this was a huge blow to my routine. 

The apple reminder app had all the functions of Alarmed! (notes, check lists, repeat etc) but the preface was not engaging at all and very drab. I don’t need it to be overstimulating but Apple was very non-visual. 

So, I decided to try Tick Tick and it had all the options I was  looking for!  (Except nag me— let me know if it does!!) 
It’s also easy to use and easy to import from apple reminders with literally ONE CLICK and has much better alert tones than apple too! 

I’m so happy I found this app!!

reviews.title: My favorite and only Todo list app.
reviews.text: I had been falling behind on my todos and today thought it would be a good idea to just print them out to keep them in mind… and even the printout is so well designed, with clear to read formatting, and organization… it made me remember how thankful I am for this tool. I started using TickTick more than a couple of years ago having outgrown other todo trackers, and have never had to look again. What I like about it? It is so well designed, so many todo apps do not seem to have had a designer involved in the process, but whoever designed TickTick fully understood how to make an intuitive, clear to read, engaging interface. I love the organization of folders tasks and sublists and that you can tag your todos, ooh the power of tagging goes unrealized by so many apps (notability hint hint). I use TickTick to organize and track my small business, my household and my family todos. The pricing, free, is amazing without any obtrusive ads. And I am also here to upgrade, which is so reasonable, compared to the math apps that I use which unreasonably expect me to pay $10 a month each —TickTick is in the $2 range for additional forward looking functionality. Thank you TicktTick for keeping me organized. I might not always get to everything that I put in there, but that feeling that you got my back motivates me to keep moving forward.

reviews.title: My dream planner and task manager
reviews.text:
TickTick is exactly the app I need! Before Tick Tick I used to manage everything by hand in a journal, which worked, but it wasn’t always convenient because I didn’t have it with me everywhere. I’ve also used the Notes app on my iPhone, but nothing compares to the satisfaction of actually checking off a task. ✅

TickTick gives me everything I need to stay productive, organized, and happy. It makes planning my day, tracking my goals, and getting things done so much easier. As a Capricorn, checking off tasks and working quickly and efficiently is my number one priority — and this app makes that possible! I genuinely love how simple, useful, and motivating it is.

In addition, I also love how it keeps track of habits too! This is the only planner i’ve ever stuck with and i’ve been using it for two years now and will never use anything else!! Only feedback would be to add in a mood tracker as well! that would really make all my other apps go away! 

Highly recommend!!

This program is awesome. It keeps me on top of everything. The phone app is great. The companion desktop app is awesome. It syncs my calendars and pulls in IOS reminders straight from my iPhone Siri button. I can drag and drop tasks right into my calendar on my desktop. It smokes Morgen,
